stories.story_fr: La croissance des positions actions et fonds dope les revenus recurrents (+6% a change constant au T3 26), portee par une participation accrue des investisseurs et des volumes de trading eleves.
stories.story_en: Strong equity and fund position growth powered recurring revenue (+6% constant currency in Q3 26), driven by higher investor participation and elevated trading volumes.
stories.quote: 6% Recurring revenue growth constant currency and 11% Adjusted EPS growth, powered by strong equity and fund position growth and higher trading volumes

stories.story_fr: Broadridge pose les fondations de sa croissance future en menant la tokenisation, la digitalisation des communications et le passage a l'echelle de l'IA.
stories.story_en: Broadridge is building future growth by leading in tokenization, driving digitization of communications, and scaling AI.
stories.quote: we are putting in place the building blocks of future growth by leading in tokenization, driving the digitization of communications, and scaling AI

stories.story_fr: La croissance interne du segment Capital Markets integre desormais 3 points, soit 7 M$, provenant des revenus d'actifs numeriques, signe de la traction de l'offre blockchain.
stories.story_en: Capital Markets internal growth now includes 3 points, or $7 million, from digital asset revenues, a sign of blockchain offering traction.
stories.quote: Internal Growth included 3pts, or $7 million, from digital asset revenues.

stories.story_fr: Fort de ses resultats, Broadridge releve sa guidance FY26 : croissance des revenus recurrents a change constant a 7% ou plus et croissance du BPA ajuste a 10-12%.
stories.story_en: On the back of strong results, Broadridge raised FY26 guidance to recurring revenue growth at or above 7% constant currency and Adjusted EPS growth of 10-12%.
stories.quote: Raising FY'26 guidance for Recurring revenue growth constant currency to At or above 7% and Adjusted EPS growth to 10-12%

stories.story_fr: Broadridge releve son dividende annuel de 11% a 3,90 $ par action, sa 19e hausse annuelle consecutive et la 13e a deux chiffres en quatorze ans.
stories.story_en: Broadridge raised its annual dividend 11% to $3.90 per share, its 19th consecutive annual increase and 13th double-digit hike in fourteen years.
stories.quote: Raising annual dividend 11% to $3.90 per share, 19th consecutive annual dividend increase
